label: Type film

kinds.title: Opening card: the film's title in large type.
kinds.line: One voice line shown as large moving type, each word appearing as the voice says it.
kinds.cta: Closing card: the one action viewers should take, with a button.

fields.line.vo: The words on screen are this line, word for word, timed to the voice (or to a recorded take).
fields.line.style: punch: one word or short phrase at a time, filling the frame. stack: short lines pile up as they are said. build: the whole sentence builds word by word.
fields.line.accent: Up to 3 words of the voice line, separated by spaces, shown in the accent colour.
fields.line.theme: light, dark (brand primary) or accent (brand secondary) background.

description: Kinetic typography: every voice line becomes large moving type, each word landing as the voice says it, one word at a time, in stacked lines or building a sentence. Best with a recorded voice or a strong voice-over and little footage.

line.vo: Every word you say lands on screen the moment you say it.
